mapper.sql: select t.token_id, t.user_id, t.name, t.token_hash, t.token_prefix, t.source, t.client_id, c.client_name, t.grant_id, t.resource, t.expires_at, t.last_used_at, t.last_used_ip, t.revoked_at, t.create_time from sys_user_access_token t left join sys_oauth_client c on c.client_id = t.client_id
mapper.select: where t.user_id = #{userId} and t.revoked_at is null and t.source in ('manual', 'oauth_refresh') order by t.create_time desc, t.token_id desc
mapper.update: update sys_user_access_token set revoked_at = #{revokedAt} where token_id = #{tokenId} and revoked_at is null
update sys_user_access_token set revoked_at = #{revokedAt} where grant_id = #{grantId} and revoked_at is null
update sys_user_access_token set revoked_at = #{revokedAt} where user_id = #{userId} and revoked_at is null
update sys_user_access_token set last_used_at = #{usedAt}, last_used_ip = #{ip} where token_id = #{tokenId}
update sys_user_access_token set last_used_at = #{usedAt}, last_used_ip = #{ip} where grant_id = #{grantId} and source = 'oauth_refresh' and revoked_at is null
mapper.delete: delete from sys_user_access_token where (revoked_at is not null and revoked_at < #{before}) or (expires_at is not null and expires_at < #{before})
